scripts.images:local: for f in images/*.svg; do wrangler r2 object put "cloudflare-lab-images/$(basename $f)" --file "$f" --content-type image/svg+xml --local; done
scripts.images:remote: for f in images/*.svg; do wrangler r2 object put "cloudflare-lab-images/$(basename $f)" --file "$f" --content-type image/svg+xml --remote; done
